reden: Not detected. The reported issues cover sqrt(0) STOP behavior, a sqrt exponent-halving bug, add/sub missing L flag after near-cancellation, comparator inconsistencies (eq/le/ge), and ln accepting zero/negative. The vulnerability described is a precision-loss bug in toPackedFloat due to determining M/L size solely from exponent and ignoring digitsMantissa, causing downcast when mantissa is in (MAX_M_DIGIT_NUMBER, MIN_L_DIGIT_NUMBER). None of the audit items identify this toPackedFloat-specific downcast/precision issue or propose the corresponding fix (consider digitsMantissa). Mentions of toPackedFloat in the audit are only about encoding differences used by comparators, not the precision-loss mechanism. Different function, mechanism, and fix.
